negative_reviews.author: Alan Reid
negative_reviews.text:
Greasy and lukewarm yaki soba.
Warm broth. Mediocre ramen.

negative_reviews.author: Melanie Ngai
negative_reviews.text:
I have been to this restaurant twice, with 1 week apart. Both times the service was good. Navin stood out in service, very helpful and friendly.
On my first visit, the food was disappointing. The Steak Tataki Raman had 4 thin small slices of steak and they were well done not rare, so a little chewy. The sushi rice in the volcano roll and soft shell crab roll was over cooked, they were like sticky rice, not nice at all.
2nd visit, the sushi rolls rice was as expected. We really enjoyed our food in our 2nd visit.
The chef must had an off day on our 1st visit.

negative_reviews.author: Amman Meah
negative_reviews.text: My server Navin was great, sashimi was good, tempura squid tasted like rubber. Mainly annoyed about the fact their bookings started from 3:45, I booked a table for 4pm the day before, arrived, and the restaurant was closed. Terrible work from them to accept bookings when they’re not even open.

negative_reviews.author: Randal Boyle
negative_reviews.text: Poor service, bad ramen, bad sushi and bad drinks. The place was understaffed but really isn’t worth a visit

negative_reviews.author: Shreena Soomarah
negative_reviews.text: Waited 10 minutes for someone to acknowledge we were waiting, even though we had reserved. Had to steal cutlery because nobody brought us any. No condiments on the table besides soya sauce. Tempura was thick and floury - not tempura. The only good part of the ramen was the broth and we had to wait 40 minutes for it. It soon became clear that this place has no interest in being a Japanese restaurant. If you’re into appearances and eat your maki with a fork and dip it into your ramen (as we saw) this is the place for you.  Even Wagamama or yo sushi are better. If you want a good Japanese restaurant for the same price go to Sanjugo. If you want fusion go to Uba. If you have more money than sense and need to be warned that you’ll be fined if you vape in the toilets (who does that???) this is the place for you.
